newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Merchant Bankers initiates Argentine CEI Citicorp.
newsitem.headline: Merchant Bankers initiates Argentine CEI Citicorp.

text.p: Merchant Bankers Asociados, an Argentine associate to Salomon Brothers, Friday said it initiated coverage of local CEI Citicorp Holdings with a buy recommendation.
"We see an upside of 35 percent plus that comes from a decline in the discount plus an increase in the net asset value," head of Research Andres Pitchon wrote in a report.
"Alternatively, it could be seen as outperforming Telefonica (de Argentina) by 16 percent."
Pitchon added there is additional upside from sharing the control of Telefonica, potential synergies between cable and telecommunications, and from acquisitions in cable and media.
"Although difficult to quantify it could add another 10 to 20 percent," he said.
Telefonica de Argentina is controlled by holding company Cointel, which is half-owned by Telefonica de Espana and CEI. About 40 percent of CEI is indirectly owned by Citibank.
A local press report said Friday CEI could buy control of TV Cable firm Cablevision TCI.
Pitchon said "that snuggly fits into CEI's aggressive strategy to become Argentina's leading media group."
He added that over the year to date CEI's stock price has increased 66 percent, while the net asset value (NAV) increased 100 percent, which "indicates more upside."
He also said CEI is trading at a 20 percent discount to NAV and that he believes the discount will decline to the seven percent range.
